messages.content: Remember: for the payments API, always run npm test before deploying. Prefer concise PR descriptions that start with the behavior change.
Added a regression test for webhook retry idempotency, fixed the duplicate retry guard, and verified that npm test now passes.
Decision: use Postgres advisory locks for payout reconciliation instead of Redis locks because the transaction boundary is easier to audit.
Created docs/migration-notes.md with the advisory-lock rollout plan and updated the PR checklist.
